name: Mike Laird
residence: Big Horn County (Greybull; Lovell Chronicle, Aug. 20, 2026)
occupation: Big Horn County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Mike Laird is a Big Horn County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Dave Neves, who is serving through the current term. The Lovell Chronicle reported that he is of Greybull and led the August 2026 Republican primary with 1,749 votes, then ran unopposed in the November general election.
